markdown.$description: Markdown: headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, tables and links, drawn as the text arrives.

flow-gap.$description: The space between blocks: paragraphs, headings, lists, quotes, code blocks, tables.

item-gap.$description: The space between the items of a list.

copy.$description: The copy button in a code block's header: its variant, tone and size.

code-more.$description: The button under a long code block that shows all its lines, and folds them again.

quote.$description: A quote (`> …`): its bar is a side of its frame.

list.$description: A list: its indent is its padding at the start.

task.$description: The box of a task item (`- [ ]`), and its check when done.

rule.$description: A horizontal rule (`---`): a side of its frame.

code-block.$description: A fenced code block: its frame and fill; `drawn` once the math door drew it in its place.

code-header.$description: The header of a code block: the language and the copy button.

code-language.$description: The language name in a code block's header.

code-text.$description: The code of a code block; its `white-space` decides whether long lines wrap.

cell.$description: A table cell, and a heading cell (`head`).

image.$description: An image, when images are allowed.

math-block.$description: Display math (`$$`): its TeX as it arrives, then what the math door drew.

math-text.$description: The TeX of math not drawn yet.

footnote-ref.$description: A footnote's reference: its number, raised, a link to the note.

footnotes.$description: The notes of the footnotes, numbered.

footnote.$description: A footnote's note: `focus` when its reference took the reader there.

footnote-back.$description: The link at the start of a note back to its reference.
